The [[Jedi Pack]] includes [[Hyperoute Navigation Chart]], a '''game aid''' listing systems by their positions on the chart.<ref>[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], [[Players Committee]], Hyperoute Navigation Chart (102_9), commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive].</ref>

The printed chart lists systems beside values from 0 to 9 and marks Yavin and Hoth as known Rebel bases.<ref>[[:File:Jedi-D-hyperoutenavigationchart.gif|Hyperoute Navigation Chart]], [[Decipher]], [[Jedi Pack]].</ref>
